# kilhog_network (Data Source)

Reads an existing Kilhog network by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kilhog_network" "production" {
  name = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Network UUID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Unique network name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Network description.
- `tags` (Map of String) Key-value metadata tags.
